summary: Iteration 3 full-stack test PASSED. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed. GET /api/catalogue returns 9 volumes with real DJ Sayd metadata — titles, years (2017-2022), sc_track (0-8), listen_url = shared SC playlist for all. Vol 08 plays='530K' verified. Admin CRUD accepts year/plays/sc_track (create + update + persistence verified). Frontend: Landing renders 9 catalogue cards each with title, year (top-right), plays badge, and ÉCOUTER <button>. Clicking Vol 08 ÉCOUTER opens sc-player-modal with iframe src containing url=<playlist> and start_track=7; Vol 01 -> start_track=0 confirmed. Modal header shows VOL. 08 — LIVE BIRTHDAY. Close button dismisses modal. TopNav /logo-gm.png loads (HTTP 200) with CSS filter 'invert(1) brightness(1.1)'. Footer has all 4 social links (social-ig-goodmood, social-ig-sayd, social-vevo, social-soundcloud) with correct hrefs. Newsletter POST works. Admin login redirects to /admin dashboard which lists all 9 real titles.

issues: Admin table only shows columns Number/Title/Order — new fields (Year, Plays, sc_track) are accepted by backend PUT but not exposed as columns or edit fields in the admin UI. Admin cannot edit year/plays through the dashboard, only via direct API call. Recommend adding these fields to the admin edit form.

Console warning: 'Encrypted Media access blocked by Feature Policy'. Cosmetic — audio playback still works because tracks aren't DRM-protected. Consider allow="autoplay; encrypted-media" on iframe if playback issues arise.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Expose year/plays/sc_track fields in admin edit form (currently only backend supports them).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup migration force-updates title/year/plays/listen_url/sc_track/description on every startup based on `number` — safe and idempotent for real catalogue but will silently overwrite any admin edits to those fields on next backend restart. Consider gating the migration behind a one-shot flag/env var.

Previous iter 2 test file (test_soundcloud_integration.py) is now stale — it asserts Vol 01 listen_url='forss/flickermood' which no longer matches. Left in place per policy (not removing tests written by prior agents), but should be removed or updated by main agent. Iter 3 tests are in test_catalogue_real_data.py.
SoundCloudPlayer.jsx iframe should include allow="autoplay; encrypted-media" to silence Permissions Policy warnings.
Frontend Landing.jsx has no i18n content for the new social/CVLN footer — hardcoded English/French strings; consider moving to translations.
